summary: Comprehensive testing of Rehabilified physiotherapy education platform. All backend APIs passed (15/15 tests). Frontend UI testing completed successfully - homepage, consultation deep-link page, auth modal, dashboard, and admin panel all working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working. Backend API tests in /app/backend/tests/test_rehabilified_api.py cover health check, content API, auth endpoints (Google OAuth redirect, logout, auth/me), consultation slots (30-min and 60-min), admin auth, purchases, and payments. Frontend tested: homepage sections, favicon with cache-busting, manifest.json, consultation deep-link page with Share/Copy buttons, slot booking modal with date picker (Mon-Thu only), auth modal with Google sign-in, dashboard sign-in prompt, admin login. Valid consultation date for testing: use Mon-Thu within next 7 days.
